author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a correctness concern (e.g. loading strong dependencies synchronously) already has an existing framework or mechanism elsewhere in the codebase, use it instead of building ad hoc logic for it.
fix_shape: reuse the existing loading/dependency framework instead of inventing new logic

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the existing typed helper functions for converting/parsing a reference representation instead of hand-rolling the conversion.
fix_shape: call the existing EncodedReference/DXN helper instead of inline parsing

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not nest a module's exports under a name that duplicates the module's own export name (avoid `Module.ClassName.member`); export members directly at the top level.
fix_shape: hoist the members to top-level exports of the module

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When re-exporting internal implementation functions under public names, import the internal module as a namespace (`import * as internal from './internal'`) rather than aliasing each export with a suffix like `foo$`.
fix_shape: import the internal module as a namespace and reference `internal.foo`

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Remove a type that is redundant because a higher-level (API) type already defines the same field.
fix_shape: delete the redundant type and rely on the existing one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add an extra layer to a type hierarchy when the existing module already defines the field directly; keep the hierarchy flat.
fix_shape: flatten the interface instead of introducing a new inheriting type

author: dmaretskyi

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Delete a type that only duplicates or parallels an existing one instead of growing a separate type hierarchy for it.
fix_shape: remove the redundant type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Prefer a single generic type parameterized over the variant instead of building a separate parallel type hierarchy per variant.
fix_shape: add a type parameter to the shared type instead of one type per case

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Hoist behavior or fields shared across variants into the common base type instead of duplicating them in each subtype.
fix_shape: move the shared member up to the base type

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Type-only cross-imports between API modules are safe and do not create circular-dependency problems, so they need not be avoided the way value imports are.
fix_shape: use `import type` for the cross-module reference instead of avoiding the import

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not add a package-specific workaround to a config without justifying what makes that package different from its peers that don't need it.
fix_shape: remove the workaround unless the difference is explained, or document why it is needed

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't keep both a shorthand top-level accessor and the original nested version doing the same thing; move the definition and drop the redundant one.
fix_shape: delete the old nested accessor after moving/aliasing the definition to the top level

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When migrating or refactoring an existing implementation, edit it in place rather than creating a parallel new file for it.
fix_shape: modify the existing file directly instead of adding a new one

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Route generated/external types through the canonical shared package rather than importing them directly from their origin package in individual modules.
fix_shape: add the needed re-export to the canonical package and import from there

author: dmaretskyi
principle: A resource-lifecycle-scoped job or task should be created once as a class-scoped field and opened/closed in the resource lifecycle hooks, not created and torn down ad hoc.
fix_shape: construct the job in the class field and drive it from the resource open/close methods

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Never cast around a type mismatch; a cast hides a real underlying error instead of fixing it.
fix_shape: fix the actual type mismatch instead of casting

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When a component loses state unexpectedly (e.g. across a reload), fix the underlying lifecycle so the state persists, rather than adding compensating re-initialization code in the caller or test.
fix_shape: move the initialization to the correct lifecycle scope instead of re-triggering it manually afterward

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Never use `as any` to satisfy the type-checker; fix the underlying type mismatch instead.
fix_shape: resolve the real type incompatibility instead of casting to any

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a local re-export of a type or service that its own package already exports; import it directly from that package instead.
fix_shape: delete the local re-export and import from the source package

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When two representations don't line up, convert the data at its owning layer instead of casting past the mismatch at the call site.
fix_shape: implement the conversion in the owning module rather than casting downstream
